name: Bellubrunnus
sum: Tiny rhamphorhynchid from the Late Jurassic (Kimmeridgian) of Brunn, Bavaria, unusual for its forward-curving wingtips.
material: Single complete articulated skeleton in ventral view, missing only parts of the right foot and tail tip.
biology: Very large eyes and about 22 pointed teeth; likely took small prey. Lacks the long tail-vertebra projections of other rhamphorhynchids.
author: Hone et al. 2012
